2.1. Paper2Figure Dual Multi-agent System                         form textual descriptions into an executable FigScript spec-
Paper2Figure employs a dual multi-agent architecture that         ification. The Plan Agent first analyzes the input user in-
mirrors the workflow of professional scientific illustrators.     struction to extract entities, processes, and logical relation-
It consists of two cooperative subsystems, the Generation         ships, then formulates a high-level plan that defines the fig-
Agents and the Refinement Agents, which interact through          ure’s modular structure, flow direction, and hierarchical or-
the intermediate representation language FigScript. All           ganization. The Module Agent subsequently implements
agents are implemented using GPT-4o, ensuring consistent          this plan by constructing visual modules in FigScript, en-
reasoning capability and high-quality language–vision un-         coding nodes, edges, containers, and labels that represent
derstanding across the entire pipeline. This design enables       the key semantic units of the description. The Layout Agent
the system to progressively construct and improve figures         then refines the spatial organization by adjusting alignment,
while maintaining consistency. Each agent specializes in a        edge routing, spacing, and grouping, aiming for a compact
distinct aspect of figure creation, ensuring both logical ac-     and visually balanced composition. The outcome of this
curacy and aesthetic optimization across stages. We formal-       stage is a complete FigScript file that can be deterministi-
